data.content_ref: inline:Reframe commitment as case-relative: each committed root is associated with a set of contextual assumptions, and the extension is the set of nodes accepted in at least one context, with a skeptical combination (e.g., intersection of label sets across contexts). This extends SRC_008 into a multi-context framework. Criticizable: may lead to exponential contexts; determinism may be lost unless contexts are totally ordered.
